links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and integrity of chatbot answers to living kidney donor FAQs
links.effect: Copilot lowest: accuracy 3.35 (3.18, 3.52), integrity 3.40 (3.09, 3.71); ChatGPT-4.0 highest: accuracy 4.05 (3.89, 4.21), integrity 4.00 (3.82, 4.18).
links.quote: In contrast, ChatGPT-4.0 achieved the highest median accuracy [4.05 (3.89, 4.21)] and integrity [4.00 (3.82, 4.18)], closely followed by ChatGPT-3.5[4.01 (3.88, 4.16)], [3.98 (3.85, 4.11)].

screen.reason: Evaluates four commercial LLMs on answering frequently asked questions for living kidney donors using expert rubric scoring, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
